subject: [PATCH] proc/task_mmu: handle special PMDs in clear_refs and pagemap

reviews.author: Gregory Price
reviews.summary: Responded to Andrew's concern by stating that he tagged the patch as stable and erring on the side of backporting, but offered to drop the stable tag if deemed unnecessary.

2026-09-15.patch_summary: Patch addresses handling of special PMDs in clear_refs and pagemap functions.

reviews.author: Andrew Morton
reviews.summary: Expressed concern that the patch may leave known bugs in the code and suggested retaining the cc:stable tag.
reviews.raw_body:
On Tue, 15 Sep 2026 01:19:50 -0400 Gregory Price <gourry@gourry.net> wrote:

> > > Fixes: 3c8e44c9b369 ("mm: mark special bits for huge pfn mappings when inject")
> > > Cc: <stable@vger.kernel.org> # v6.19+
> > 
> > Why cc:stable?  Is a crafted test driver the only way of hitting this?
> > 
> 
> Technically reachable via mshv_vtl_low, so i tagged it stable.

I have no idea what this means, but I pasted it in ;)

> It's hard to make a judgment call on some of these - so I err on the
> side of backporting.  Feel free to drop stable if you think it's not
> worth it.

I retained the cc:stable.  It's disturbing to leave known bugs in there
because we *think* nobody can reach them.  What if we're wrong about that?

2026-09-14.patch_summary: Patch addresses handling of special PMDs in clear_refs and pagemap functions.
